question: The Commission has set six priorities for 2019-20241, with the Green Deal listed as the first of these. The Commission’s website features a list of initiatives linked to the Green Deal (around 1502) or its sub-sections, such as Fit For 55 (193), among others. However, according to my findings, there is no complete list of legislative proposals falling under this Commission flagship policy. 1.
Does the Commission have a publicly available list of all legislative proposals (excluding delegated and implementing acts) it has issued in the period 2019-2024 under the auspices of the Green Deal?
If no such list has been published, does the Commission intend to publish one in the near future, or can it be attached to the answer to this question?
answer: During the 2019-2024 mandate, the Commission adopted a total of 108 pieces of legislation under the European Green Deal headline ambition. This list encompasses areas related to climate, environment, agriculture, fisheries, transport and energy policy. The annexed list compiles these proposals. These initiatives include: —
New policies, such as the Social Climate Fund or the Union certification framework for carbon removals.
Updates of existing legislation, such as the CO2 emission performance standards for new passenger cars and new light commercial vehicles.
Measures linked to the energy crisis, such as the REPowerEU plan and gas demand reduction.

The list excludes recurring proposals linked to fisheries, emergency measures in response to the COVID-19 pandemic and proposals linked to the implementation of the EU-United Kingdom withdrawal agreement. This list does not specify whether interinstitutional negotiations are completed. See annex: Annex
